paragraphs: The product line covers two all-electric school buses, the LionC and the LionD. The LionC is the Type C bus and the LionD is the Type D bus. Alongside the buses, the site lists a set of EV services tied to fleet operation.

LionEnergy covers energy consulting and charging solutions. LionGrants covers grant monitoring, writing and maximization. LionAssistance covers technical support, vehicle assistance, and parts. Support is offered on-site or remotely for technical issues.
The service listings also include maintenance and warranty.

quote.text: A complete set of EV services dedicated to your fleet's success.
